summary: AIxCrypto Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the resignations of its Co-CEO Kevin Richardson II, CFO Koti Meka, and President Campbell Becher, effective May 21, 2026, with CFO resignation effective June 20, 2026. The departures are stated as not due to any disagreement with the company. Jie Sheng, a former independent director, was appointed President and CFO effective June 21, 2026. No financial terms or advisors are mentioned. The filing indicates a sudden, simultaneous exit of key executives, but the voluntary nature and lack of disagreement suggest it may be planned. Watch for further leadership or strategic shifts.
